reviews.title: Fits exactly what it was designed for.
reviews.comment: Great mid sized case for an matx, fits on my desk just fine. Upgraded from a fractal ridge cause I got tired of always worrying about gpu size and if the riser cable was working up to par. Honestly love the look and was able to fit a bequiet darkrock pro 5. Definitely one of the easier sff cases to build in. Love that I don't have to worry about gpu size in the future either. If youre upgrading from a different sff case or just want something small but just big enough to not have to worry about all your part sizes this is perfect and looks clean. The built in fans had extra connectors so I didn't even have to worry about a fan hub. Love the support for additional fans too.

reviews.title: It's fairly good - some minor flaws.
reviews.comment: The case is good. Beware, its kind of a pain. To get to your motherboard each time you have to take the top off then unscrew the fans unless you get extenders for everything. Like HDMI, Display, USB's etc. The two fans it comes with are on a bracket that I'm talking about on top that you have to unscrew then lift up. As far as cooling goes no matter which way I set up fans with my liquid cooling - the computer ran hot all the time. Eventually, I just switched to an air cooler and it made things 10 times better. I've seen builds with single fan AIO's on the top and I'm sure that would work better with fans on the side. I was running a Thermalright FW360 Ultra ARGB White CPU Water Cooler with 3 PWM Fans on the side and everything I attempted just did not work. I also replaced a lot of the cables it came with - I don't know if anyone else had the same experience but the case came with a a lot of crammed cables that felt like they were just shoved in there. The space of case is nice. DEFINETLY research the sizing of everything before you buy etc. I'm currently running a XFX Swift AMD Radeon RX 9070XT in mine and it fits the size perfectly. I only docked one star because of the difficulties that came with the case. Other than that its been a fairly good case for ITX builds.
